items.html:
Christopher Barnwell is a right-arm fast bowler in the hit-the-deck mould who can also contribute with the bat. In his first season of domestic cricket, he served notice of both his skills, with a five-wicket haul and half-centuries in the first-class and List A formats. While spinners formed the crux of Guyana's attack in their victorious 2010 Caribbean T20 campaign, Barnwell was their most consistent seamer, impressing with his nagging lengths and clever changes of pace. His spell of 1 for 19 in four overs in the final proved crucial in swinging the momentum Guyana's way after a wayward start.
